source_excerpts.20:
20. Наличные деньги принимаются и пересчитываются кассовым работником в присутствии клиента.
На рабочем месте кассового работника находятся наличные деньги клиента. Все ранее принятые наличные деньги хранятся в специальных устройствах, находящихся на рабочем месте кассового работника, закрывающихся на ключ, предназначенных для хранения наличных денег (металлический шкаф, сейф, тележка, ящики стола, тумба).

proposals.implementation: New rule/event; relates to client presence, not count omission.
must_exclude: Customer merely occluded or outside crop
Subsequent independent internal recount after completed client receipt
Actor identity inferred from face or clothing label
proposals.evidence_context: Contributing person visible leaving fully observed client zone; same receipt cash counted before service completion; use body/object continuity only.

source_excerpts.32:
32. Кассовый работник выдает клиенту банкноты полными, неполными пачками и (или) отдельными корешками банкнот по обозначенным на упаковке суммам без полистного пересчета при условии сохранения неповрежденной упаковки. Банкноты из неполных, а также поврежденных корешков выдаются кассовым работником полистным пересчетом.
Монеты, упакованные в мешки, выдаются по надписям на ярлыках, прикрепленных к мешкам, а упакованные в пакеты (тюбики, коробки) – по надписям на них. Монеты из неполных мешков выдаются кассовым работником с пересчетом по кружкам.

proposals.implementation: Split existing broad disabled controller gap: physically alone is observable if entire room and operation are known; arbitrary second-person authorization remains unavailable.
must_exclude: Customer receipt/issue exception in paragraph42
Counting prepared for a pending customer issue
Camera only covers desk rather than whole room
Controller behind partition or outside crop
proposals.evidence_context: Full relevant room continuously visible over identified independent internal operation; if any other person is present, their authority/role cannot be classified from appearance.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Physical crossing of an actual visible boundary; entering alone or with another person.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: Calling a person unauthorized from appearance, missing uniform, or unseen permission paper.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Actual vault/safe-room status; responsible-person designation; management authorization and required accompaniment. No14 service entrance is closable by design, not a rule to keep every door shut at all times.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Visible presentation/handling of a physical or digital document; no face identity.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: No paper passport in frame therefore no identification.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Whether digital identity service was used and available verification record. Organizer prohibits face identification; action checking must not become facial identity matching.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Phone handling or clothing can be generic visual facts but not legal violations.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: Any phone use, casual dress, another person or gesture automatically violates bank cash rules.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: An applicable supplied public policy. No internal ForteBank rulebook was supplied; FAQ32 says hidden expected events do not rely on internal-only rules. Collector PPE in No231 paragraphs103/109-6 concerns equipment availability/departure, not a blanket office dress rule.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Entire-room single-person internal noncustomer procedure can be evaluated automatically with full context.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: A second person is not the controller because of clothing, position, facial identity or gesture.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Roles only if another person exists; narrow P42 singleton proposal avoids that role inference.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Storage fixture and room contents where fully visible and verified as vault; see P77 conditional proposal.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: Correctness of accounting, unauthorized key access, improper safe-code sharing, or inventory shortage from gesture or object handover.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Accounting entries; responsible-person designations; internal key/stamp/code procedures paragraph80; verified room classification.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Visible tear/seal damage, opening, recounting and transfer can be detected.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: No touching/turning bag means no integrity/seal check. Eye/attention/knowledge is not established; discovery condition and electronic/alternative seals also matter.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Explicit observable impossibility plus full procedure, or trusted statement of inspection/discovery; current gesture-only detection cannot ground omission.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: Visible paper handed over or printed.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: No paper receipt seen proves no confirmation document was issued.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Permitted document/delivery channel and any electronic confirmation; cannot use bank-system absence unavailable in brief.

blocked_or_partial_gaps.automatable_observation: People and clearly visible protective equipment in full transport scene.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.not_supported: Only one collector entering a cash counter proves undersized crew, or no visible helmet/body armour means unavailable equipment. Driver/other crew may remain outside and paragraph99 permits two-person crews in specified cases.
blocked_or_partial_gaps.needed_context: Whole crew scope, route/departure phase, exceptions (online vehicle camera/dye container), actual PPE availability. One-cash-counter organizer view does not supply these.

implementation_notes: Run local automated facts/candidates over all eligible footage; no manual annotation dependency before first pass.
Keep source review/versioning separate from per-video annotation. Public possible-sign wording remains required even with automatic decisions.

Bank cash deployment scope can derive from supplied brief sections1-3/FAQ3, avoiding manual per-clip labels; still require visible workstation and procedure applicability. Do not automatically infer vault/collector/authorization context.
Never turn missing sparse observations into absent action. Omission routes need complete context, which may not meet an unmeasured sub10s target on every video.
No model, GPU, private media, labels or predictions were used in this reassessment.
A20/A11 coordination must approve schema/event/fact additions before active catalog changes.
